sourceReviewSummary: We followed the WCPSS calendar index to the 2026–27 Traditional Calendar and manually checked the dates and calendar markings against the district PDF. The official PDF states a minimum requirement of 1,025 instructional hours and does not publish an official student-day total.
sourceReviewDetails: On August 9, 2026, the WCPSS Calendar Index linked resource UUID 23c3ed21-18db-4afb-b65e-b0a305e0e94c. It resolved to the May 6 PDF with SHA-256 7809ab275eecb6a115e96002008b2dbee510f7d984e8bf0e1b779a7bacc2ad9f.
The resolved PDF was visually reviewed month by month, including first and last days, holidays, teacher workdays, vacation days, grading-period and report-card markers, and school return dates.
The derived 177-day count includes Monday–Friday dates from August 24, 2026 through June 9, 2027 and excludes each weekday marked H, W, or V on the official PDF.

The official calendar identifies October 12, February 15, and April 5 as teacher workdays that may be used for weather makeup. The index-linked PDF reviewed on August 9, 2026 also lists six banked days and five remote instruction days, with the order determined by district leadership.

calendarFaqs.q: When does school start for WCPSS traditional-calendar students in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for WCPSS traditional-calendar students is Monday, August 24, 2026. The official PDF lists teacher workdays from August 17 through August 21 before students arrive.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for WCPSS in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school for WCPSS traditional-calendar students is Wednesday, June 9, 2027. The official PDF also marks the end of the fourth nine-week grading period and report cards on June 9.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WCPSS spring break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: WCPSS spring break runs Monday, March 29 through Friday, April 2, 2027. Students are out from Friday, March 26 through Monday, April 5 because Good Friday comes immediately before the vacation block and April 5 is a teacher workday. Classes resume Tuesday, April 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WCPSS winter break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: WCPSS traditional-calendar students are out from Monday, December 21, 2026 through Friday, January 1, 2027. Classes resume Monday, January 4, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WCPSS Thanksgiving break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: WCPSS traditional-calendar students are out Wednesday, November 25 through Friday, November 27, 2026. Classes resume Monday, November 30.

whatsNew.title: What's New vs. 2025–26
content: School starts one day earlier than in 2025–26: August 24 instead of August 25.
The school year also ends two days earlier: June 9 instead of June 11.
The official spring vacation block is March 29–April 2, followed by a teacher workday on April 5; the prior calendar listed March 30–April 6.
Good Friday on March 26 now connects directly to spring break, creating an extended student no-school window through April 5.

customSections.label: Weather Makeup Days
customSections.content:
WCPSS identifies October 12, February 15, and April 5 as teacher workdays that may be used for weather makeup. They remain student no-school days unless district leadership changes the calendar after a closure.

When this page was reviewed on August 9, 2026, the Traditional Calendar linked from the WCPSS calendar index listed six banked days and five remote instruction days. The calendar states a minimum requirement of 1,025 instructional hours and does not publish an official student-day total.

calendarNotes:
This page covers the WCPSS 2026–27 Traditional Calendar. WCPSS publishes separate year-round, modified, and specialized calendars with different dates.

Traditional-calendar students start August 24, 2026 and finish June 9, 2027. Thanksgiving break is November 25–27, winter break is December 21–January 1, and spring break is March 29–April 2. Students resume classes April 6 after the April 5 teacher workday.
